source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Αναστάσιος ο Νεομάρτυρας από την Παραμυθιά της Ηπείρου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The head line gives him «(; - 1750)» and the body states the day and the year of the beheading, so a `death` is proposed. The page: of Paramythia in Epirus; at harvest time he was in the fields with his sister and other Christians and came to blows with some Turks who attacked his sister with evil intent; stung by the fight, they slandered him to the pasha, saying he had given his word to change his faith; the pasha arrested him and pressed him, and he answered that he had never given such a word — «Χριστιανός γεννήθηκα, χριστιανός και θα πεθάνω με τη βοήθεια του Χριστού μου» — and that he cared nothing for the goods offered him, having many eternal goods in the heavens; by those words he made a Christian of the pasha's son, named Musa, of whom the page says that «κάποιες πληροφορίες αναφέρουν ότι μετονομάστηκε Δημήτριος και μάλιστα μαρτύρησε για τον Χριστό»; and he himself, after the most dreadful torture in prison, was beheaded outside Paramythia near a monastery on 18 November 1750, and the monks of that monastery buried his relic with honours. **The son is named in the life and carries no link and no `related` row**: what the page says of his renaming and his own martyrdom it marks as «κάποιες πληροφορίες», and no folder of the corpus was identified with him. No `locations`, following this wave's practice. No hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «τελικά αποκεφαλίστηκε έξω από την Παραμυθιά κοντά σ' ένα Μοναστήρι στις 18 Νοεμβρίου 1750 μ.Χ.», and the head line «(; - 1750)». The page gives no year of birth.
